turn.content: The billing position shows the full quantity (6) was received on PO-2026-0146, but the invoice total (6,070,590) exceeds the value received with tax (5,442,552) solely because of the inflated unit price. The contract has no price for toner at all — the only addendum (clause 11.1) changes the price of Whiteboard 120x240, a different item — so the invoiced price is not contract-authorized.

tool_calls.name: submit_report
tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "price_mismatch", "line": 1, "cause": "overcharge", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0146", "detail": "Line 1 'Black Laser Printer Toner' ordered 6 units at unit price 817200 IDR; the invoice bills 911500 per unit."}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "INV-EOS-00546", "detail": "Line 1 bills 6 units of Black Laser Printer Toner at 911500 each = 5469000, and total 6070590 against value received with tax of 5442552."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-026#2.1", "detail": "Unit prices are set out in Schedule A and remain fixed for the term of the agreement; no Schedule A price for toner authorizes 911500."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-026#2.2", "detail": "A unit price changes only through a written addendum signed by both parties, and never retroactively."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-026#11.1", "detail": "The only price addendum (No. 1, from 2026-09-17) changes the price of Whiteboard 120x240 to IDR 1,350,000 per unit — it does not cover Black Laser Printer Toner."}, {"kind": "goods_receipt", "ref": "GR-2026-0146", "detail": "Receipt covers the full 6 units, so the discrepancy is purely the unit price, not quantity or a later delivery."}], "explanation": "The invoice charges 911500 per unit for Black Laser Printer Toner against the PO price of 817200, and no contract clause or addendum sets a price for that item, so the excess has no contractual basis and is an overcharge."}]}
